ud5.1:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
ud5.1:1.3: tena kho pana samayena rājā pasenadi kosalo mallikāya deviyā saddhiṃ uparipāsādavaragato hoti.
ud5.1:1.4: atha kho rājā pasenadi kosalo mallikaṃ deviṃ etadavoca
ud5.1:1.5: atthi nu kho te mallike kocañño attanā piyataroti.
ud5.1:2.1: natthi kho me mahārāja kocañño attanā piyataro
ud5.1:2.2: tuyhaṃ pana mahārāja atthañño koci attanā piyataroti.
ud5.1:2.3: mayhampi mallike natthañño koci attanā piyataroti.
ud5.1:3.1: atha kho rājā pasendi kosalo pāsādā orohitvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho rājā pasenadi kosalo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
ud5.1:4.1: idhāhaṃ bhante mallikāya deviyā saddhiṃ uparipāsādavaragato mallikaṃ deviṃ etadavoca
ud5.1:4.2: atthi nu kho te mallike kocañño attanā piyataroti
ud5.1:4.4: natthi kho me mahārāja kocañño attanā piyataro
ud5.1:4.5: tuyhaṃ pana mahārāja atthañño koci attanā piyataroti
ud5.1:4.6: evaṃ vuttehaṃ bhante mallikaṃ deviṃ etadavocaṃ
ud5.1:4.7: mayhampi kho mallike natthañño koci attanā piyataroti.
ud5.1:5.1: atha kho bhagavā etamatthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi
ud5.1:6.4: tasmā na hiṃse paraṃ attakāmoti. suttaṃ
